archetypes.name: hook-coverage-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: Cross-check marker lifecycle, hook release mappings, and structural lint coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether every background launch named in the plan has exactly one outer bg-wait marker owner. Verify the hook sentinel mappings match the marker STEP values and that Step 4 foreground probing remains allowed. Check that /review and /review-and-fix cannot add run_in_background without updating the marker mapping. Cite specific files and tests in each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
